model_annotations.German: The plot illustrates the training and validation loss over a range of steps. The x-axis, labeled "Steps", has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 250, with tick labels at intervals of 50. The y-axis, labeled "Loss", also has a linear scale, ranging from 0.02 to 0.07, with tick labels at intervals of 0.01. The plot displays two lines: the blue line represents "Training Loss" and has a solid line style with circular markers, starting at approximately 0.072 at 0 steps and decreasing to around 0.024 at 240 steps, with a steep decline initially, followed by a gradual decrease; the orange line represents "Validation Loss" and also has a solid line style with circular markers, starting at around 0.045 at 0 steps and decreasing to approximately 0.017 at 240 steps, with a similar trend to the training loss.
